title: Playschool Franchise Opportunity
name: Lighthouse Preschool, 2 Franchisees, Est'd in 2023, Petaling Jaya HQ
description: Lighthouse Preschool is a bilingual, play-based early childhood education centre in Malaysia, established three years ago. - Inspired by the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) framework, integrating English and Mandarin through interactive play, structured literacy, and numeracy activities. - Caters to children aged 18 months to 6 years. - Currently operates two company-owned branches: one in Ara Damansara, Petaling Jaya, which serves as the main headquarters, and another in Desa ParkCity, Kepong. - Has 30 enrolled children at the Ara Damansara branch and 10 at the Desa ParkCity branch. - Equipped with indoor play areas, reception areas, washrooms, and a library to support children's learning and development. - Holds registration with the Companies Commission of Malaysia (SSM) and a Ministry of Education licence. - Plans to expand through franchising in the Kuala Lumpur area.
